findings.title: Untrusted input to integer conversion
findings.trigger: Passing a malicious string to argv[1]
findings.assumptions: The input to the program is controlled by an attacker.

findings.title: Integer division leading to truncation
findings.assumptions: N is a large number and numProcessors is small, leading to an integer division that truncates the result.

findings.title: Race condition in shared memory
findings.trigger: Multiple child processes accessing shared memory concurrently
findings.assumptions: Multiple child processes may access shared memory segments concurrently without proper synchronization.

findings.title: Resource leak in shared memory cleanup
findings.sink: shmctl(shmidA, IPC_RMID, NULL); shmctl(shmidB, IPC_RMID, NULL); shmctl(shmidC, IPC_RMID, NULL);
findings.assumptions: If any child process fails to detach the shared memory segments, the cleanup may not occur.
